accepted_findings.reason: The candidate advertises a confined MCP stderr log but retains only an in-memory digest. This breaks the explicit server-log evidence boundary on real success and failure paths. Persisting the already-drained bounded bytes is a localized change whose evidence benefit outweighs its low complexity and regression risk.

The pinned server loads .env from the same checkout used as its working directory, while Git cleanliness does not exclude ignored files. A fail-closed exact-root .env rejection is a small prelaunch check that closes an otherwise unreviewed physical-routing configuration channel.
